note: The format has no `created` or `generator` on the document, no `notes` on any object, and no `data` on a folder (SPEC 3.1, 3.10). Each is an unrecognised key (SPEC 6.2): diagnose it at its path, skip the key, keep the object. A reader that recognises any of them reports fewer than four diagnostics here. `created` holds a well-formed UTC timestamp, so a reader that checks it as a timestamp and not as an unknown key reports nothing at `/created`. The point's own `data` record is recognised and raises nothing, so a reader that drops `data` from every item, not only from a folder, loses the record and fails the tree of a write; `counts` pins the folder and the point that survive, and the point's position shows the point was read. The schema leaves the document, a folder and a point open to other keys, so the file is valid there.
